item.title: How will tariffs affect the midterms? In this Michigan border town, it's complicated
item.description: The recent trade war between the U.S. and Canada has both economic and political implications for Michigan, given it's the state's top trade partner.

item.title: Whistleblower's lawyer warns USPS plan for Trump's order could keep ballots from voters
item.description: A lawyer for an anonymous whistleblower says Postal Service plans for an unusual verification rule, combined with a hastily built online system, could delay mail ballots from reaching eligible voters.
item.content:encoded:
A lawyer for an anonymous whistleblower says Postal Service plans for an unusual verification rule, combined with a hastily built online system, could delay mail ballots from reaching eligible voters.

item.title: Trump attempts to combat high gas prices as affordability crisis looms over midterms
item.description: President Trump seems to be pulling out all the stops to mitigate high gas prices ahead of the midterms.

item.title: Political consultant on how the cost-of-living is affecting Trump's approval rating
item.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with political consultant Sarah Longwell about Trump's low approval rating and high gas prices, as affordability shadows the approaching midterm election.

item.title: Incumbent Sen. Ed Markey wins Massachusetts' Democratic primary for U.S. Senate
item.description: Bucking a push for younger leadership this election season, Sen. Ed Markey, 80, won the Democratic nomination against Rep. Seth Moulton, 47, who said that his party needed new leaders.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: North Carolina Rep. Chuck Edwards is formally censured over harassment allegations
item.description: The censure vote drew bipartisan support, and followed an investigation by the House Ethics Committee into allegations of sexual harassment against two young female staff members.

item.title: Trump's pro-data center stance is putting pressure on Republicans ahead of midterms
item.description: Trump's pro-data center stance is out of step with voters. Republicans are trying to navigate the issue but it's putting them at odds with the president's AI agenda.

item.title: USPS 'carefully reviewing' whistleblower claim on plan for Trump's mail in voting order
item.description: A whistleblower says the U.S. Postal Service is rushing out an online system for President Trump's push to restrict mail voting that could "derail" the midterm election if courts allow it to proceed.
